summary:
I ran out of tool budget during the final verification run. Here is exactly what state things are in.

## Code complete and verified (unit level)

- `src/context_eval/mod.rs` — module glue, adapter drive loop (Rust runner via `LLXPRT_CODE_RS_BIN` + isolated `LLXPRT_CONFIG_HOME` + unique session; TS reference runner via `bun --preload ./scripts/dev-env.ts packages/cli/index.ts` with isolated settings), bounded artifact publication. Registered as `pub mod context_eval;` in `src/lib.rs`.
- `src/context_eval/tests.rs` — **8 self-tests, all passing**: malformed-report detection, false-success injection caught by the grader (`UnexpectedGreen` impossible when the provider never issued the marker), manifest schema rejection (`deny_unknown_fields`, bad schema version, owner_phase 0, 17 tool rounds, runner argv in a manifest), fixture-size bound, bounded artifact capture, deterministic fixture expansion with unique per-round index lines, and exact adapter command construction including the TS invocation.
- `src/bin/llxprt-context-eval.rs` + `[[bin]]` in `Cargo.toml`; xtask `context-evals` arm added. No new dependencies (only `serde`/`serde_json`/`toml`/`sha2`/`clap` already in the lockfile).
- `cargo fmt --all` run; `cargo clippy --offline --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean; `cargo test --offline --locked --lib context_eval` → **8 passed, 0 failed**.
- One real bug found and fixed during the run: every scenario TOML referenced fixtures without their extensions (`.txt`/`.md`). All 17 now resolve against `evals/context-management/fixtures/`.

## Not finished — and I will not claim otherwise

1. **The end-to-end baseline was never completed.** Both driver runs hit the 120 s shell timeout (each spawns 17 scenarios × real subprocesses against the loopback; the earlier single run reached manifest loading, proving the driver starts). So I have **no per-scenario result to report**. `cargo xtask context-evals` was not exercised end-to-end.
2. **TS reference run failed with exit 127** — `bun` is not on PATH in this shell, so the reference validation did not happen. It needs `--ts-bin` pointed at the actual Bun binary or PATH adjusted.
3. **No commit was made** (the commit step never executed because the run timed out before it). Nothing was pushed. Branch remains `issue37-phase0-eval-harness`.

## To finish (about 3 commands)

```
./target/debug/llxprt-context-eval --runner rust --out tmp/issue37-baseline \
  > tmp/issue37-p0-baseline.json 2> tmp/issue37-p0-baseline.txt        # allow 10-20 min
./target/debug/llxprt-context-eval --runner ts --scenarios wall-large-tool-final \
  --out tmp/issue37-ts > tmp/issue37-p0-ts-reference.txt               # after locating bun
git add ... && git commit -m "context-evals: Phase 0 ... (#37)"
```

Every scenario must come back `expected-red` (never `harness-error`, never `unexpected-green`), and the three wall scenarios must show `reason_class = context-limit` with `wall_hit = true`. If any reports `harness-error`, that is an infrastructure bug in my adapter, not a valid red baseline.
